svg.title: Lens formula and magnification card
svg.desc: A formula card showing 1/v − 1/u = 1/f highlighted at top, the magnification m = v/u underneath, and a worked example for a convex lens with f = +20 cm and u = −30 cm: solving gives v = +60 cm (real image) and m = −2 (inverted, twice as large).
svg.text: Cartesian sign convention: distances measured from the lens; light travels left → right is positive.
Worked example — convex lens, f = +20 cm, u = −30 cm:
→ v = +60 cm (real image, on the right)
Same formula handles convex (f > 0) and concave (f < 0). Negative m = inverted image.
